title: Montoute
meta_description: This 5BR home comes with a private outdoor pool, two balconies, and a stunning design --- all just 2 blocks from the beach and restaurants. Experience the best of Emerald Coast at Montoute.
description_expanded:
Welcome to Montoute! This 5-bedroom, 4-bathroom retreat is a mere 2-minute stroll to the sun-kissed shores of the Emerald Coast.

Inside, Montoute shines with a bright, contemporary design. The spacious main living room, featuring a large sectional sofa and TV, is ideal for group movie nights. Share meals and memories at the dining table, or enjoy a casual breakfast at the barstools in the fully equipped kitchen, complete with sleek finishes and high-end appliances. A second living area offers additional space for your group to spread out and unwind.

Head to the backyard to discover your private pool oasis. With an abundance of loungers and poolside seating, there's plenty of room for everyone to soak up the sun and enjoy the salty sea air. Fire up the grill for an evening BBQ and dine alfresco at the covered outdoor dining area. Or, head up to one of two spacious balconies, each complete with tables and chairs.

Five comfortable bedrooms offer a variety of sleeping arrangements to accommodate the whole group. The primary bedroom boasts a king bed, TV, and ensuite bathroom for added privacy, while three additional full bathrooms ensure plenty of privacy for everyone.

Montoute puts you at the heart of all that the Emerald Coast has to offer. Public Beach Access 47 is just a 2 minute walk away, so you can spend your days basking in the sugar-white sands and bright blue waters. A variety of restaurants are within short walking distance making your stay even more effortless.

Embrace the elegance and ease of coastal living at Montoute -- your perfect beachside getaway!

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Hub 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Laguna Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Please note the pool is not heated.

Parking Details:
- 4 parking spaces in the driveway.

A pack n' play travel crib can be provided upon request with at least 24hrs advanced notice.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
